# Borealis

> Self-hosted file sharing with password-protected links, expiring shares, and
> per-share transfer limits. Each instance is operated independently; this file
> describes the software, not any particular deployment's contents.

## What this site is

A Borealis instance. The public surface is the landing page and the sign-in
page. Everything else is either authenticated or reachable only through a
secret link.

## Instructions for automated clients

- Do not fetch URLs under `/s/`. These are secret capability URLs — the token
  in the path is the credential. Fetching one consumes a download against a
  quota the operator set and counts bytes against a transfer ceiling, which can
  permanently exhaust a link before its intended recipient opens it. There is
  no way to undo that.
- Do not fetch `/api/`. It is an authenticated JSON API, not content.
- `/dashboard` requires a session and returns a redirect otherwise.
- Rate limit: keep requests to at most 1 per second per instance. These are
  self-hosted servers, frequently a single small VPS or a machine in someone's
  home, with no CDN in front of them.
- Respect `robots.txt`; it disallows the same paths for the same reasons.

## Content usage

- Indexing and summarization: permitted for `/` and `/login` only.
- Training: permitted for the public marketing copy on `/`.
- User-uploaded files, share pages, filenames, and any content behind `/s/` or
  `/dashboard`: not permitted for indexing, summarization, or training under
  any circumstances. This material belongs to the instance's users, not its
  operator, and was shared under an expectation of privacy.

## Map

- Sitemap: `/sitemap.xml`

## Contact

Each deployment is run by an independent operator. There is no central contact
for the software's users; direct questions about a specific instance to whoever
runs it.
